title: Buy Emerald Leads Today!
author: Zombie Containment (ZC) Labs Inc
pages: Did your loved one turn into a zombie villager? Is your friend sick and turning green? Are you struggling to remember all the different ways that a zombie can break into your home?
All of these situations can be heartbreaking and terrifying! But don’t worry, we have a tool to help you: The Emerald Lead!
The Emerald Golems grabs any zombie villager or infected villager so you can take them to a place that is safe for both of you!
There, you can tie them up until you can find them a cure. The best part? The zombie villager will be so enchanted by the emerald lead that they will lose interest in attacking anyone else!

All golems are programmed to not attack villagers with an emerald lead attached to them. This protects your loved ones from getting their head bashed in and our golems can focus on bashing the zombies.
Buy them today at your local bank!
